title: US-JEPA: A Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture for Ultrasound
abstract: arXiv:2602.19322v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Ultrasound (US) imaging poses unique challenges for representation learning due to its inherently noisy acquisition process. The low signal-to-noise ratio and stochastic speckle patterns hinder standard self-supervised learning methods relying on a pixel-level reconstruction objective. Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) address this drawback by predicting masked latent representations rather than raw pixels. However, standard approaches depend on hyperparameter-brittle and computationally expensive online teachers updated via exponential moving average. We propose US-JEPA, a self-supervised framework that adopts the Static-teacher Asymmetric Latent Training (SALT) objective. By using a frozen, domain-specific teacher to provide stable latent targets, US-JEPA decouples student-teacher optimization and pushes the student to expand upon the semantic priors of the teacher. translated_title: US-JEPA：一种面向超声影像的联合嵌入预测架构
translated_abstract: arXiv:2602.19322v2 公告类型：replace-cross 摘要：超声成像因其固有噪声较大的采集过程，为表征学习带来了独特的挑战。低信噪比和随机散斑模式阻碍了依赖像素级重建目标的标准自监督学习方法。联合嵌入预测架构（JEPAs）通过预测被掩码的潜在表示而非原始像素来解决这一缺陷。然而，标准方法依赖于通过指数移动平均更新的在线教师模型，这类模型对超参数敏感且计算开销大。我们提出了US-JEPA，一种采用静态教师非对称潜在训练（SALT）目标的自监督框架。通过使用冻结的、特定领域的教师模型提供稳定的潜在目标，US-JEPA解耦了师生模型的优化过程，并推动学生模型在教师模型的语义先验基础上进行扩展。此外，我们还提供了首个严格的……（原文截断）
tldr: US-JEPA提出了一种采用静态教师非对称潜在训练（SALT）目标的自监督框架，利用冻结的领域特定教师模型提供稳定的潜在目标，解决了超声影像低信噪比环境下的表征学习难题，同时避免了传统JEPA中在线教师模型超参数敏感和高计算开销的缺陷。
en_tdlr: US-JEPA is a self-supervised framework that adopts the Static-teacher Asymmetric Latent Training (SALT) objective, using a frozen domain-specific teacher to provide stable latent targets, thereby overcoming ultrasound imaging's representation learning challenges while avoiding the hyperparameter-brittle and computationally expensive online teachers of standard JEPAs.
